title: Prime Access Trailer/Voruna
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - "The drums are silent. The Emperors lie butchered by Tenno blade.
Yesterday we lay languid on our couches of gold. Today that gold festoons the ingrate hordes.
How they howl, these motherless pups. The gods are dying. Our twilight has come, in the hour of the rising wolf.
Did I not foretell our ending? I gasp. I lust after this preferred death. At last, immortality has savor.
And I ponder, beast: Do you have MY scent? Voruna."
- This is the first Warframe trailer overall to be explicitly marked as NSFW (Not Safe For Work) due to the intense gore it has.
